banned.claim: Drinking Protean will help you lose weight or burn fat
banned.why: Disease/weight-loss outcome claim - 'burns fat' and 'safe for my weight loss journey' language is banned for this category.

banned.claim: Protean boosts metabolism, boosts immunity, or restores thinning hair
banned.why: Unqualified structure/function and immunity claims are banned; not supported by product-specific evidence.
Health-outcome claim tied to a diet/medical state - not permitted without qualification.

banned.claim: Great choice for those with insulin sensitivity / diabetes
banned.why: Implied disease-treatment claim - banned for food and beverage.

banned.claim: Headlining '100% Natural' or 'clean' as a standalone benefit
banned.why: 'Natural' and 'clean' are vague and risky as headline claims under the category rules.

banned.claim: Your body utilizes 99.9% of each serving vs 33% for other brands
banned.why: Absolute performance/comparative claim requires the actual clinical substantiation on file; do not run without it.
